title: Meta's New Stock Class Aims to Help Zuckerberg Pay Proposed Tax
excerpt: Meta has introduced a new stock class partially designed to help CEO Mark Zuckerberg pay California's proposed billionaire tax.
body_html:
Meta has introduced a newly launched stock class that was partly engineered to assist company founder and CEO Mark Zuckerberg. The financial mechanism is intended to help him pay a proposed billionaire tax in California, should the measure eventually become law.

According to reports, the specialized stock offering is designed to address potential tax liabilities while allowing Zuckerberg to maintain his control over Meta. The proposed state measure has prompted corporate and financial preparations regarding executive wealth and voting power preservation.
